senses.definition: To operate a vehicle:

subsenses.definition: (transitive, ergative) To operate (a wheeled motorized vehicle).
examples: The bridges weren't strong enough to drive (campers) over.

subsenses.definition: (intransitive) To travel by operating a wheeled motorized vehicle.
examples: I drive to work every day.

subsenses.definition: (transitive) To convey (a person, etc.) in a wheeled motorized vehicle.
examples: My cousin drove me to the airport.

subsenses.definition: (transitive, slang, aviation) To operate (an aircraft); to pilot.
examples: drive a 737

subsenses.definition: (transitive, intransitive) To direct a vehicle powered by a horse, ox or similar animal.
